name: Standby – Coming Soon & Maintenance
author: thejaydip

sections.description:
Standby – Coming Soon & Maintenance is a modern, lightweight, and highly customizable plugin that allows you to put your website into Coming Soon or Maintenance Mode with professional templates and advanced features.

Key Highlights

  • Switch instantly between Coming Soon and Maintenance Mode
  • 100% responsive, super-fast, and SEO-friendly
  • Built using core WordPress standards
  • Works with any theme or page builder
  • No coding required

Features

Professional Templates

  • Clean and minimal template design
  • Optimized typography and spacing

Background Customization

  • Solid color
  • Custom image

Countdown Timer

  • Enable/disable countdown
  • Set end date / time
  • Auto-disable when countdown ends

Email / Newsletter

  • Built-in email subscription form
  • Honeypot spam protection
  • Admin notification
  • API support for:
    • Mailchimp
    • Brevo

Access Control

  • IP Whitelist
  • Allow logged-in users to bypass

Advanced Options

  • Social icons (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter)
  • Contact email / help / address

Admin Interface

  • Fully polished design
  • Tabbed settings panel
  • Contextual help links

How to Use

  1. Go to Standby → Settings
  2. Choose:
    • Coming Soon Mode
    • Maintenance Mode
  3. Select your template
  4. Customize:
    • Logo URL
    • Title & Description
    • Background
    • Countdown
    • Social icons
    • Contact info
    • Email subscription
  5. Save and activate

External Services

This plugin connects to third-party email marketing services to allow users to subscribe visitors to mailing lists.

Mailchimp

Used to add subscribers to a Mailchimp mailing list.
Data sent: Email address entered by the user.
When: Only when the subscription form is submitted.
Service provided by Mailchimp:
https://mailchimp.com/legal/terms/
https://mailchimp.com/legal/privacy/

Brevo (Sendinblue)

Used to add subscribers to a Brevo contact list.
Data sent: Email address entered by the user.
When: Only when the subscription form is submitted.
Service provided by Brevo:
https://www.brevo.com/legal/termsofuse/
https://www.brevo.com/legal/privacypolicy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/standby-coming-soon-maintenance
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Standby → Dashboard
  4. Enable Coming Soon or Maintenance Mode
  5. Customize the template and you’re done
sections.faq:
1. Does this work with any WordPress theme?

Yes! It works with all themes including Astra, Divi, GeneratePress, Block Themes, etc.

2. Does it affect SEO?

Coming Soon Mode: Does not affect SEO
Maintenance Mode: Sends 503 response header (recommended for downtime)

3. Can I allow only certain people to access the site?

Yes. You can allow:
– Logged-in users
– Selected IP addresses

5. Does the plugin collect any data?

No. It is fully GDPR-compliant and does not track anything.

6. Will this slow down my website?

Not at all — the plugin is extremely lightweight and optimized.
